raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Six gfx95 block-FP8 producers request row-major scales and then materialize the bpreshuffle layout with an extra GPU copy. This was visible in GLM-5.3 decode as one relayout launch per affected layer. Native `Fp8LinearMethod` checkpoints reach these branches after #39409; block-FP8 implementations exposing `weight_scale` can reach them on current main.

This supersedes #34589 and #24476 with a current-main implementation, based on the approaches from @amd-mvarjoka and @Jacob0226.

## Modifications

Use the existing `emit_transposed_bpreshuffle_scale` gate at the remaining communicator, MLA, and MHA fused-RMS producers. For `M >= 2`, AITER emits the target layout and SGLang applies a zero-copy stride view; `M == 1` keeps the existing materialize path. Extend fused-RMS tests across residual and unquantized-output combinations.

## Accuracy Tests

- Transposed and row-major producer paths are bit-exact for quantized values, scales, residual output, and the DSA bf16 payload.
- GLM-5.3 EAGLE sentinel: 949 samples, mean accept length 3.7189, p50 3.60, with no observed regression.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

GLM-5.3 MXFP4, MI355X, TP8, EAGLE 5 steps, concurrency 6 (`M=36`):

- Decode step: 17.175 ms to 16.943 ms (-1.35%), three runs per arm with disjoint ranges.
- Kernel launches: 2078 to 2000 per step; the 78 removed launches match the affected layer count.
- Trace attribution measured the removed relayout copies at 0.297 ms per step.

Measurement: three alternating runs per arm after graph capture/warmup; 50 replays per op, 20 calls per graph.

<details><summary>Commands and local checks</summary>

```bash
SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 SGLANG_TOPK_MB=1 SGLANG_MQA_VARCTX=1 \
python3 profile_decode.py --tp-size 8 --ep-size 1 \
  --model-path /shared_nfs/models/GLM-5.3-Quark-MXFP4-AttnFP8 \
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --context-length 262144 \
  --dsa-prefill-backend tilelang --dsa-decode-backend tilelang \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.80 --trust-remote-code --max-running-requests 32 \
  --cuda-graph-max-bs 32 --speculative-algorithm EAGLE \
  --speculative-num-steps 5 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 \
  --speculative-num-draft-tokens 6 --ISL 100000 --CONC 6

pre-commit run --files \
  python/sglang/srt/layers/layer_boundary/residual/add_norm.py \
  python/sglang/srt/models/deepseek_common/attention_forward_methods/forward_mha_rocm.py \
  python/sglang/srt/models/deepseek_common/attention_forward_methods/forward_mla_rocm.py \
  test/registered/kernels/ops/layernorm/test_fused_rms_fp8_group_quant.py
```

The three methods in `TestFusedRMSFP8GroupQuant` passed in parallel on GPUs 4–6 (four subtests each).

</details>

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Add unit tests.
- [x] Documentation is not needed; no user-facing interface changes.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed results.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

Please rebase onto current `main` and push again; see [CI maintenance #21065](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/21065). The AMD label gate passed; GPU results are still pending.
The scale layout matches the existing consumers, with the M=1 fallback and BF16 side outputs preserved. The fused-RMS regression passed in AMD CI.

+                ):

+                    else:

+                self.assertEqual(repaired.data_ptr(), scale_transposed.data_ptr())
